name: PM-KISAN
benefit: ₹6,000 per year in 3 instalments, paid to bank account
how: Apply on the PM-KISAN portal or at a Common Service Centre; complete e-KYC.

rules.label: You do not pay income tax

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
benefit: Health cover up to ₹5 lakh per family per year for hospital treatment
how: Check your name on the PM-JAY portal or visit an empanelled hospital's Ayushman Mitra desk.

rules.label: Age 70+ OR low household income (about ₹2.5 lakh or less)

name: PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
benefit: ₹2 lakh life cover for about ₹436 per year
how: Enrol through your bank; premium is auto-debited.

name: PM Suraksha Bima Yojana
benefit: ₹2 lakh accident cover for about ₹20 per year
how: Enrol through your bank; premium is auto-debited.

name: Atal Pension Yojana
benefit: Guaranteed pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 per month after age 60
how: Open through your bank; choose pension amount and pay a small monthly contribution.

rules.label: You do not pay income tax

name: PM Ujjwala Yojana
benefit: Free LPG connection for the household, with a subsidy on refills
how: Apply at a nearby LPG distributor or online on the PMUY site.

rules.label: Low household income (about ₹2 lakh or less)

name: PM Awas Yojana
benefit: Financial help to build or buy a pucca house
how: Apply via the PMAY portal, your Gram Panchayat or urban local body.

rules.label: You do not own a pucca house

name: PM SVANidhi
benefit: Collateral-free working-capital loan for street vendors, starting at ₹10,000
how: Apply on the PM SVANidhi portal with your vendor certificate or ULB letter.

name: PM MUDRA Loan
benefit: Business loans without collateral, up to ₹20 lakh
how: Apply at any bank, NBFC or microfinance institution with a short business plan.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
benefit: High-interest savings account for a girl child's education and marriage
how: Open at any post office or authorised bank; minimum deposit is ₹250 per year.

how: Register free on the e-Shram portal or at a Common Service Centre.
